name: Stencil aperture ratio (IPC-7525)
description: Check that each solder-paste stencil aperture will release paste cleanly, per the IPC-7525 area-ratio and aspect-ratio rules.
what_it_measures: Area ratio (aperture area / aperture wall area = area / (perimeter x foil thickness)) and aspect ratio (min opening width / foil thickness) for each paste aperture.
